title: Learning Rational Strategies for Temporal Objectives in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22287v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ($\mathsf{PLTL}_f}$). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent's probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile -- if one exists -- such that (i) the designated agent's probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response

translated_title: 多智能体系统中面向时序目标的理性策略学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有未知动态的随机多智能体系统的理性综合问题，其中每个智能体都拥有自己的概率时序目标，该目标使用有限轨迹上的概率线性时序逻辑（PLTL_f）进行规约。我们将解概念（如纳什均衡、子博弈完美均衡）作为联合策略组合上的约束，其收益由每个智能体满足其时序目标的概率导出。特别地，我们将面向单个智能体的理性综合形式化为寻找一个策略组合（如果存在的话），使得：(i) 指定智能体的概率时序约束得到满足，且 该策略组合在所选解概念下构成一个稳定解。我们为表格型 Nash-Q 学习给出了条件收敛保证，利用同时有限样本置信界来认证时序约束的满足性，并通过近似最佳响应来评估策略的稳定性。
tldr: 该论文针对动态未知的多智能体系统，将纳什均衡等解概念与 PLTL_f 概率时序目标相结合，提出了一种基于带收敛保证的 Nash-Q 学习和有限样本置信界的理性综合方法，能够学习到既满足时序约束又具备策略稳定性的联合策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rational synthesis approach for multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics that integrates solution concepts such as Nash equilibrium with PLTL_f probabilistic temporal objectives, using Nash-Q learning with convergence guarantees and finite-sample confidence bounds to learn joint strategies that satisfy temporal constraints while remaining strategically stable.
